[SWS_DM_00949] Generation and usage of internal DiagnosticDataEle- ments
⌈
If an internal DiagnosticDataElement with context "DEM" gets used
when the error memory is read out via diagnostic communication, the DM shall use the
current value of that internal data element at the time when the error memory
is read out.
⌋
